description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of tasks associated with various language families or groups. The vertical axis contains the categories, which are ordered from top to bottom in descending order based on their values: IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque. There is no explicit label for the vertical axis. The horizontal value axis is labeled "# tasks" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with numeric tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 10, accompanied by corresponding vertical grid lines. Each category is represented by a single horizontal bar outlined in black, with each bar assigned a distinct color. The longest bar represents IE-Slavic in light blue with an approximate value of 79. This is followed by IE-Romance in dark blue at approximately 47, IE-Germanic in light green at approximately 44, Uralic in dark green at 20, IE-Baltic in light pink at approximately 17, IE-other in red at 15, IE-Indic in light tan at 10, Semitic in dark orange at approximately 8, and Turkic in light purple at approximately 4. The shortest bar represents Basque in dark purple with an approximate value of 3. The chart background features a subtle speckled texture, and all bars are visually emphasized with a thin black border.
